evidence.quote: You fill in your digital authorisation during your application in the online Studielink environment.

notes: Tuition: the programme page itself gives no fee. The €10,308 is stated as the institutional fee for non-EEA nationality at Avans (bachelor's and master's degree students, 2026-2027) and is quoted; it may be checked whether it applies to this programme. Application deadline: the tuition-fees page says non-EEA students must apply by May 1st, but the quote does not state day, month and year for a specific intake, so no intake deadline is given as a fact. No document list found on the pages.

note.fr: Vérifiez les conditions d'admission pour l'ICT bachelor (hbo-opleiding). Le site indique seulement les profils havo/vwo et mbo-niveau 4 admis.
note.en: Check admission requirements for the ICT bachelor (hbo-opleiding). The site only lists admitted havo/vwo profiles and mbo-niveau 4.
